fusions.name: Rot in the Joints
fusions.desc: A strike into the mortar joints that deals 12 damage, leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Dry Rot Bloom
fusions.desc: Bursts the rot through the stonework around you, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, ignoring armour, with a 50% chance to leave each one [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Damp Pillar
fusions.desc: After a 0.5-second cast, sets up a mould-furred pillar for 12 seconds. Every 1.5 seconds it fires spores at an enemy within 5 tiles and deals 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Mycelial Mortar
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 14, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
